core.title: Stainless Steel Curve Leverset, AHI SIG151

text.description_html:
AHI SIG151, Stainless Steel Curve Door Lever

This AHI made Stainless Steel Curve Leverset exemplifies the contemporary design aesthetic by making something that have could been too simple into something that looks sharp and interesting. There is something totally unique about this lever and rose set, the delicate thinness of the grip or the way it seems perched onto of the rose, that adds an extra feeling of style to the SIG151 Curve Lever. Easy to install, it will fit standard door preparations. Made out of stainless steel, the Curve Lever is available in passage, privacy, and dummy functions. Stainless steel is extremely resistant to corrosion, knocks, scratches and abrasions. Since it does not degrade in appearance or function even after many years of hard use, this leverset can be used in any commercial or residential setting where durability and style are desired. The Curve Stainless Steel Leverset is ADA compliant. It is available in satin stainless steel or polished stainless steel finish. This lever and rose set can be adjusted for 1-3/8 inch to 2 inch thick doors with 2-3/8 inch or 2-3/4 inch backsets.

Features of the AHI SIG151 Stainless Steel Curve Leverset:

  • Material: Stainless Steel
  • For residential or commercial applications
  • Fits standard door cut outs (2-1/8" pre-drilled doors)
  • Field reversible tubular latch
  • Premium latch requires only 28° rotation to retract latchbolt
  • Meets standards of the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA)

Specifications of the SIG151 Stainless Steel Curve Lever:

  • Lever Length: 5.75" (146 mm)
  • Lever Projection: 2.24" (57 mm)
  • Spindle Width: 0.31" (8 mm)
  • Rose Diameter: 2.52" (64 mm)
  • Door Thickness: adjustable for 1-3/8" to 2"
  • Backset: 2-3/8" or 2-3/4"

When Selecting a Function:

  • Single Dummy: For use as a door pull or to match trim. Trim is on one side of door. Lever is surface mounted (mounting plate screws to the doors face).
  • Double Dummy: No door latch. Door levers on both sides of the door. For use with a standard 2-1/8" bore hole pre-drilled door.
  • Passage (hall or closet): For doors that don't need locking. Latch operates from either side of door.
  • Privacy (bedroom or bathroom): For doors that could need privacy locking. Latch operates from either side. Push button on interior rose engages privacy; emergency release hole is on exterior rose. Turning inside lever will release privacy push button and retract the door latch.

Note: Single Dummy is Handed. All other functions are non-handed. Handing Guide
